mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_members (trip_plan_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{tripPlanId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, u.email AS email, u.nickname AS nickname, m.role AS role, m.created_at AS created_at FROM trip_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.trip_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
